keyset.title: Keyset
keyset.profile_new_tip: Create a profile copied from the current bindings
keyset.compare_hint: Select differences to copy from the source into the active profile. Actions missing from the source cannot be copied.
keyset.compare_no_differences: These profiles have the same bindings.
keyset.compare_missing_source_hint: This action has no source binding and cannot be copied.
keyset.compare_changed: Profiles changed. Review the updated differences before applying.
keyset.search_syntax_tip: Use @category, #ctrl/#shift/#alt or $key. Parentheses, braces and brackets restrict a term to category, modifier or key.
keyset.keyboard_hint: Select an action, then click a key or mouse button
keyset.capture_binding_tip: Click, then press a key or mouse button
keyset.virtual_key_tip: Click to filter by %s; while capturing, assign this input
keyset.capture_prompt: Assigning %s · Escape removes the whole binding
keyset.reset_all_prompt: All bindings will return to their defaults.
keyset.error_generic: Could not save this change. Check the log and try again.
keyset.error.shared_conflict: Settings changed in another Minecraft instance. Review the updated values and try again.
keyset.error.shared_sync: Cannot refresh shared settings. Your current bindings are retained.
keyset.error.recovered: A damaged profile was recovered from backup.
keyset.error.storage: Profile storage could not be read or written. Check the game log.
keyset.conflict_replace_tip: Unbind this combination from all other conflicting actions
keyset.conflict_swap_tip: Move the other action to this action’s previous binding: %s
keyset.conflict_swap_unavailable: Available after assigning a key that conflicts with one other action
keyset.conflict_gone: This conflict has been resolved or changed.
keyset.conflict_changed: Bindings changed in another window. Review the conflict again.
keyset.auto_profile_requires_world: Join a world or server to set an automatic profile
keyset.auto_profile_set_tip: Use %s for this world or server
keyset.selection_empty: Choose an action on the right
keyset.selection_hint: Press a key or mouse button · Escape unbinds.
keyset.footer_hint: Changes save immediately · Escape closes the editor
keyset.native_hint: MaLiLib hotkey · press a combination, then release its keys
keyset.native_capture_prompt: Press a combination, then release · Escape unbinds
keyset.transfer_import_prompt: Import profiles from %s JSON file(s) in the shared Keyset transfer folder? Identical profiles will be skipped.
keyset.transfer_exported: Profile exported to the shared Keyset transfer folder. Other Minecraft builds can access it.
keyset.transfer_duplicate: No new profiles. These profiles are already present.
keyset.transfer_empty: Place exported profile JSON files in the shared Keyset transfer folder first.
